title: Mock External APIs with responses Library
description: Runnable pytest suite for mocking HTTP calls with the responses library: basic mocks, matchers for query params and headers, error simulation, retry sequences, dynamic callbacks, request-body assertions, and a shared RequestsMock fixture.
description_es: Suite pytest ejecutable para mockear llamadas HTTP con la librería responses: mocks básicos, matchers de query params y headers, simulación de errores, secuencias de retry, callbacks dinámicos, aserciones sobre el request body y un fixture RequestsMock compartido.
